extracted.name: Cream Dill Sauce
extracted.description: This tangy dill sauce with mayo and sour cream is lovely drizzled over warm roasted potatoes, but it’s also good as a dip for raw vegetables!
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, green onions, dill, and lemon juice. Mix well and chill for at least 1 hour.
